import hashlib, json
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd()
manifest=json.loads((root.parent/"evidence/review-input-v4.json").read_text())
bad=[]
for rel, expected in manifest["files"].items():
    actual=hashlib.sha256((root/rel).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    if actual != expected:
        bad.append({"file":rel,"expected":expected,"actual":actual})
assert manifest["base"]=="8febe19ad7d2a41301104b8efe5ff6bed7b3ccab"
assert not bad,bad
print({"manifest":"review-input-v4.json","files":len(manifest["files"]),"hashes":"match","base":manifest["base"]})
